śuṣamastu . cakāttam Āyirattu Aññūṟṟukkumel cellāniṉṟa vikkiṟamavaruṣam Āṭimātam Iraṇṭāvatu perampalattuṟaiyum paṇṭāram nāyakkar Ayyaṉ mutaliyār Ayyaṉ Ivarkaḷ muṉpāka vakai yaṟṟapaṭi muṉṉāḷ taṟmacādha ttiyattukkum paṟṟivarukiṟa nāṉūṟṟu Aṉpatu poṉṉum kāṇikkaikku kaṭṭaḷai
nātatevapaṇṭārattukku rāmīcuram pūcakar sicantiracekaraUṭaiyar ciṣyarāṉa caṟuvecarakurukkaḷ poṉ Irunūṟṟu Aṉpatu Ākap poṉ Eḻunūṟum canṉativācalile paṟṟikkoṇṭu cuvāmiyāṟku kāṇikkai kalluk kaṟaṭu paṭṭup vati pacu yāṉai kutirai maiṣāntiram yetu vantālum e
ṇapaṭṭar meṉācciṉapaṭṭa rāmacantiramutaliyār rāmāyaṇapaṭṭar Aṉavarumom māramaṅkala poṉ ṉeḻunūṟum paṟṟikkoṇṭu pūcai parikāram kuṟaivaṟa paṇṇivarakkaṭavomānaom . yintappaṭikku maturai cokkanātaṉ caṉṉati kopuravācalile kalveṭṭuppaṭikku tappāma
mutal yiṉṉāḻikaivaraiyum vanta kāṇikkai rāmanātaṉukku yirukūṟum Eṅkaḷukku munṟukūṟumāka naṭantuvarukaiyil rāmappāṇāyaṉpaṭṭaṇattil rācāUpaiyam veḷḷittaṭikkum cuvāmi Irāmanātaṉ pātattāṇaiye Eṅkaḷ Ācāriyar Āṇaiye nāyakkar Ayyaṉ pātattāṇaiye tappāmal naṭakkakkaṭavomākavum ṉāḷ 1kku tiṉappaṭi cuvantiram pūcaippaṇamum Eppoḻutu
vantu Atu mukāntiramāka maturaikkup poy vicuvanātanāyakka virappanāyakkar Ayyaṉ mutaliyār Appa yaṉṟu teciyaṉ Aṉavaru mippiracātam Arici 1paṭi cantaṇam pātiyum Uruttirar Aviṣekac cuvatantiramum paṟṟikkoṇṭu pūcai kuṟṟamaṟa paṇṇikkoṇṭu mirukkakkaṭavomākavum . Intappaṭikku Akitampaṇṇiṉavaṉ keṅkaiyilum cetuvi
